title: Datasheet bench: free-air impedance and on-axis half-space SPL (theory-only)
description: A moving-coil driver parameterised by its primary set (fs, Qms, Qes, Re, Mms, Sd), for fitting a datasheet's plotted impedance and on-axis SPL together (docs/fitting.md, 'calibrated SPL'). Both faces open to ambient: Mms, Cms and Rms include the air load of free air, as the driver records' do. The pressure probe p_1m reads the on-axis far-field pressure of the front face in half space at distance_m: the series inertance rho/(2 pi r) (rho of dry air at 23 C, the netlist's air) carries the front volume velocity U, and its pressure drop j w rho U/(2 pi r) is that pressure, exact on axis for a rigid baffled piston at any ka. Its load on the driver, Sd^2 rho/(2 pi r) = 0.19 mg at 10 cm2 and 1 m, is negligible. baffle_air_mg adds the air mass an infinite baffle puts on the diaphragm beyond free air, for a curve measured in a baffle (docs/spec-errata.md E5). Unlike examples/driver_bench.json (the physical set, no SPL read-out), the primary-set parameters keep the impedance's fs, Qms, Qes and Re as fitted quantities, and the SPL level then fixes Mms (docs/fitting.md, 'spl_known_load'). Used by tools/driver/digitize_hpd40_2016.py.

baffle_air_mg.label: Air mass added by an infinite baffle (0 = free air)
baffle_air_mg.description: For a rigid disc of radius a the air load is (8/3) rho a^3 in free air and (8/3) rho a^3 per face in an infinite baffle, so the baffle adds (8/3) rho a^3: 18.05 mg for Sd = 10 cm2.
